evidence: SDF gradient blends of 0.50 and 0.75 gave the best balanced and best distance geometry results respectively, but matched previews retained panel fish-scale patterns and central support diffusion.
goal: Test whether constraining Gaussian motion to the learned SDF tangent space or applying a conservative Stage-D zero-set projection reduces residual surface artifacts.

variants.blend050_tangent: 0.50 blend plus tangent-projected mean gradients in C/D
variants.blend075_tangent: 0.75 blend plus tangent-projected mean gradients in C/D
variants.blend050_project_d: 0.50 blend plus conservative Stage-D SDF projection
variants.blend075_project_d: 0.75 blend plus conservative Stage-D SDF projection

projection: Every 500 iterations in Stage D, step 0.025, maximum displacement 0.001 m.
fixed: Complete K4 preset, 240 training views, seed 42, 12k, four stages, split threshold 5e-5, all other settings unchanged.
parallel_policy: Exactly six variants, all six submitted concurrently on the 12GB GPU.
robustness_policy: Incomplete K5-test3 and K9-test7 manifests are used only after all six training runs complete.
